description: Provision an Azure Insights ActivityLogAlert via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the insights.azure.com/v1api20201001 ActivityLogAlert spec.

actions.description: Actions: The actions that will activate when the condition is met.

actionGroups.description: ActionGroups: The list of the Action Groups.

items.description: A pointer to an Azure Action Group.

actionGroupReference.description: ActionGroupReference: The resource ID of the Action Group. This cannot be null or empty.

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

webhookProperties.description:
WebhookProperties: the dictionary of custom properties to include with the post operation. These data are appended to
the webhook payload.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

condition.description: Condition: The condition that will cause this alert to activate.

allOf.description: AllOf: The list of Activity Log Alert rule conditions.

items.description:
An Activity Log Alert rule condition that is met when all its member conditions are met.
Each condition can be of one of
the following types:
__Important__: Each type has its unique subset of properties. Properties from different types
CANNOT exist in one condition.
* __Leaf Condition -__ must contain 'field' and either 'equals' or 'containsAny'.
_Please note, 'anyOf' should __not__ be set in a Leaf Condition._
* __AnyOf Condition -__ must contain __only__
'anyOf' (which is an array of Leaf Conditions).
_Please note, 'field', 'equals' and 'containsAny' should __not__ be
set in an AnyOf Condition._

anyOf.description: AnyOf: An Activity Log Alert rule condition that is met when at least one of its member leaf conditions are met.

items.description:
An Activity Log Alert rule condition that is met by comparing the field and value of an Activity Log event.
This
condition must contain 'field' and either 'equals' or 'containsAny'.

containsAny.description:
ContainsAny: The value of the event's field will be compared to the values in this array (case-insensitive) to determine
if the condition is met.

equals.description:
Equals: The value of the event's field will be compared to this value (case-insensitive) to determine if the condition
is met.

field.description:
Field: The name of the Activity Log event's field that this condition will examine.
The possible values for this field are (case-insensitive): 'resourceId', 'category', 'caller', 'level', 'operationName',
'resourceGroup', 'resourceProvider', 'status', 'subStatus', 'resourceType', or anything beginning with 'properties'.

containsAny.description:

if the condition is met.

is met.

field.description:

The possible values for this field are (case-insensitive): 'resourceId', 'category', 'caller', 'level', 'operationName',
'resourceGroup', 'resourceProvider', 'status', 'subStatus', 'resourceType', or anything beginning with 'properties'.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.

description.description: Description: A description of this Activity Log Alert rule.

enabled.description:
Enabled: Indicates whether this Activity Log Alert rule is enabled. If an Activity Log Alert rule is not enabled, then
none of its actions will be activated.

location.description:
Location: The location of the resource. Azure Activity Log Alert rules are supported on Global, West Europe and North
Europe regions.

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.
